metadata.name: Supabase Node RAG
metadata.description:
Overview: A Next.js and Supabase pgvector RAG backend that isolates secrets, retrieval, and providers behind server modules.
When to avoid: Avoid for sophisticated multi-tenant authorization, streaming ingestion, or long-running background workflows.
Layers: Client UI, route handlers, server modules, shared types, generated database types, and seed tooling.

rules.diagnostic: Client code crosses the server-only boundary by importing a server module or marker.
rules.remediation: Expose the operation through an API route and keep the implementation in lib/server.

rules.diagnostic: Client code crosses the data-access boundary by importing the Supabase SDK directly.
rules.remediation: Call a Route Handler and keep Supabase access in a server module.
